exposure: Timing of brain tumor diagnosis (during pregnancy, before pregnancy with preconception counselling, before pregnancy without preconception counselling)
cohort: 20 women (23 pregnancies) diagnosed with a brain tumor (excluding pituitary adenomas, metastasis, and vascular tumors) at a single referral centre from January 2003 to July 2011
finding: Poor perinatal outcomes and maternal death were associated with unplanned pregnancies and brain tumors diagnosed during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth with epidural analgesia was observed in all groups, including those with brain tumors diagnosed during pregnancy.
gest_age: Varied, including term and preterm births
